name: hero_watch
views: the front view, dial facing the camera
the right side view, the crown and two pushers facing the camera
the back view, the steel caseback facing the camera
the left side view: a plain smooth case side with no crown and no pushers
story: Why: a slow display-window turn that lets a buyer see every side. 360 degrees in four quarter turns, ends where it started (loops).
storyboard_prompt: Image 1 is the product photo: use exactly this product, its shape, materials, colours and logos. Create ONE storyboard image made of a 2x2 grid of four equal photo panels, edge to edge, with no borders, no gaps, no text and no numbers. Shot on a 35mm film camera, Kodak Portra 400, visible film grain, slight halation around highlights, natural unretouched colours, a real photograph, not a render. Every panel: Studio product shot, camera locked off at the height of the dial, 85mm lens, only a faint focus breathing. The watch is fastened around a small upright cream suede watch cushion on a slowly rotating black turntable in front of a dark charcoal backdrop; no hands, no people. One softbox from the upper left as the only key light, a thin warm rim light from behind; the right side falls into shadow, real reflections slide over the gold bezel, a few specks of dust on the crystal. Exactly one watch in each panel: a men's two-tone chronograph wristwatch: a round polished gold-tone stepped bezel, a white textured dial with gold Arabic numerals and gold baton markers, three small white sub-dials, gold hands, a small date window at three o'clock, the word FOSSIL on the dial, a gold crown between two gold pushers on the RIGHT side of the case only, and a brushed silver steel link bracelet with thin gold edges on every link. Panel 1 (top left): the FRONT view: the white dial faces the camera. Panel 2 (top right): the RIGHT side view: the gold crown and the two gold pushers face the camera, the dial edge-on. Panel 3 (bottom left): the BACK view: the polished steel caseback with four small screws and the bracelet clasp face the camera. Panel 4 (bottom right): the LEFT side view: the plain smooth left side of the case faces the camera, with NO crown and NO pushers, the dial edge-on. The crown and pushers exist ONLY on the right side: they must not appear in the left side view. The same camera, backdrop, turntable, cushion and light in all four panels; the watch stays centred and the same size. Candid, unretouched photographs with natural imperfections: real dust, fingerprints, uneven light, slight lens vignetting. No extra products, no added text, no watermark.
